description: Ministry of Education - Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978 Order  Under Section 25 A
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order made under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, amending Schedule II to a previous order. It establishes regulatory conditions for degree programs and specifies academic qualifications, which falls under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
